name: Samsara

rate_limits: Endpoint-level rate limits introduced Oct 2023, completed Dec 1 2023; numbers per endpoint not retrieved (see developers.samsara.com/docs/rate-limits, unverified)
terms_notes: Listing process not described on auth page; check partner terms
notes: Auth page fetched directly. Rate limit numbers and listing criteria not read.

name: Motive (KeepTruckin)
auth: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (app registered in developer portal, client id/secret, code TTL 10 min, per-app permissions e.g. vehicles, users, HOS, documents); API key also exists for own-account use (not verified)
data_read: Portal categories: Users, Vehicles, Vehicle Gateway, Groups, HOS Logs, Locations, Messaging, Inspection Reports (DVIR), IFTA Reports, Fault Codes, Driver Performance, Webhooks
